reviews.text: I have had the most amazing experience with Adam, the owner. My dog Mickey was hit by a ball at daycare (accidents happen and that’s okay), Adam called me right away when he found out. We deeply appreciate his and his team’s support. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to send their dog to daycare.

Bruno loves Throw Me a Bone so much!!! He has gone to 2 of their locations and pulls me to the door each time.  They take such great care of him and love his as their own.  His big smile and wagging tail say it all!
Brittney was awesome! my babies look amazing!! do yourself the favor!
Very friendly staff. My puppy was happy at the end and friendly toward the staff.

Our dog was terrified of going to the groomer after some negative experiences at other groomers. Upon picking her up from Throw me a Bone, I have never seen her happier post grooming. Not only was she happy to see me, she was incredibly affectionate with the groomer—a clear sign they had treated her gently, kindly, and with love. 10/10 would recommend.

We sent our rescue dog Frida to her first assesment and then she stayed for 3 more hours, she was having the BEST time at Throw me a Bone! Even though she is very very energetic, they knew how to handle her and were super patient with my pitsky! We'll definitely send her more to daycare!
Thank you Saylor! We appreciate you and are glad you're happy with the experience!

Our dog had a great time at the dog daycare and was so excited to be there and play with everyone there. The entire process was smooth and easy and we loved that there were many photo updates throughout the day.

Any questions we had were promptly communicated and answered and the staff were all very kind and gentle in handling her. Highly recommend.

We moved to NYC a little over a year ago and have had a difficult time finding a groomer who is not only highly skilled, but passionate about dogs in the city. Safe to say we’ve found our go to groomer - Wesley! He is highly experienced and I’ve never seen my dog gladly approach a groomer, let alone kiss them! My dog is quite anxious with grooming and I was surprised to see him very happy. It just goes to show how well Wesley treats pets! Thank you, Wesley! You’ve earned a lifetime customer :)

I couldn’t be happier with the experience! I have been using the same groomer for years and after a couple bad experiences lately I decided to give this place a try.  From the moment we walked in, it was clear that Wesley genuinely cares about both pets and their owners. He was warm, attentive, and incredibly patient, taking the time to understand exactly what I wanted and making sure my dog felt comfortable every step of the way.  I have a very hyper active Pomeranian who isn’t very trusting and he was immediately comfortable with Wesley.
The results were amazing—my dog has never looked (or smelled!) better. The cut was precise, the coat was soft and shiny, and even the little details like the nails and ears were handled perfectly. What really stood out was how calm and happy my dog seemed afterward, which says everything about the level of care and professionalism here.
It’s rare to find a place that combines skill, kindness, and consistency so well. I’ll absolutely be coming back and recommending this groomer to anyone who wants their pet treated like family.
I appreciate the photo updates of my happy cats!
My dog Roco loved it here. I really appreciate what great care they took of him, and also the photos of him playing with the other dogs! Will definitely be using TMAB in the future.
Great haircut and great service. Staff was very friendly and took wonderful care of my dog. Couldn’t of asked for a better experience
Thank you Cesar! We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
10/10 recommend Throw Me a Bone for all of your dog-related needs!
Love this place!!
Great experience. Jacob loves it!

Nellie looks great! Perfect cut. I've been taking her to Throw Me a Bone on 42nd for several years now. And every time is great. She's happy when she realizes where we're going, and the work they do to remove all the shedding is super helpful. Thanks Wesley!

My little ones are on the older side and TMAB provides that extra attention and care senior dogs need. They both enjoy their time and I feel comfortable leaving them for a few days. The photos are a treat and I look forward to their report cards! All pet owners want a safe and mindful space.

I came here to get my dog’s nails trimmed and they did an amazing job. I was very impressed with how quick they were able to do it while also making sure every nail was done well. I’ll definitely come back regularly.

Benjamin loves to
go and play with his friends. Grooming there is also great
The groomer and everyone on staff are amazing-facilities are super clean-really great experience
Awesome! They are great. Treated my two Jack Russells with the utmost care. The staff are so sweet and kind. Wesley the groomer he did great job on Max and Princess.

Throw Me a Bone is amazing. Ozzy, our little man, loves going here for daycare. The staff is fantastic, and the facility is very well kept. Knowing our boy is in good hands makes the day go by much easier. Highly recommend. 🐾
Super friendly staff! They did great job at deshedding my Shiba and she smells so good after the luxury bath. High recommended!
Our little dog is obsessed with this place! They take such good care of him. It’s also a great place for grooming. This is a one-stop shop run by people who treat your pet like family.
Just moved to NYC and I love that every time I bring my pup for daycare he is super excited to be there. Everyone who works there is an awesome dog lover!

I have taken my dog to other daycares before and I trust TMaB the most. It's not too crowded, there's enough staff to watch all the pups, and I love to check in on the webcam while I'm at work. The app is very convenient for scheduling and the facility is always clean. I feel safe and confident leaving my dog here for the day.
TMAB always takes great care of Yuki! The grooming services are spectacular!!!!
TMAB always takes amazing care of Yuki. Their grooming services are also spectacular!!!!
i’ve been sending my dog to day care here for four years. Definitely the best place for the dog to go to daycare. I wouldn’t recommend anywhere else. My dog pumpkin loves it here!

We are very grateful to have Throw Me A Bone in our building.  Booking online is super easy, and emails and calls are answered fast and friendly.  Our dog Atticus is adjusting well with us returning to work, and we feel comfortable leaving him home knowing that he's receiving such good care.

I am overjoyed how convenient and top quality Throw Me a Bone is.  My doggie was showered with love and cared for!  Caroline did an amazing job and I was thrilled.  She went above and beyond and ot showed on my pup's face!  I'm so happy to be able to use this business again.
My dog was just groomed last week and they did an amazing job as always!!

The Throw Me a Bone staff always does a phenomenal job with grooming my golden retriever. They never cut more than what they're asked to and follow instructions carefully. I'd highly recommend their services to anyone looking for a groom for their pup in Hells Kitchen area.
Great care and wonderful service'
Friendly and professional staff who greet you and your pup with a smile and provide the best service!
Always professional and on time Courteous very pleased with the service.And everyone is always takes the time to listen 👂
They were great with my cat Daisy! She felt very comfortable at her nail trim and they did a great job.
This place was great!  My first time there and I'll definitely be returning as a regular.  Super friendly staff and squeezed me into their schedule the same day I called.
Great treatment of Zander. Quick nail trim, paw treatment, and deshedding. Quick and easy, and Zander's paws are perfect!

I bring Thor into TMAB on 42nd once a week and have been since we moved to NYC in March, and it’s easily his favorite day of the weeks. He drags me across 11th avenue as soon as he realizes we’re going to daycare! The staff is amazing, even during the summer when they had an AC issue they took the dogs to their 52nd st location without any additional charges and provided free drop off/pick up services for those impacted. I’ve also had him groomed once at TMAB and they did an amazing job. All around, this is a hidden gem in HK, and I am so glad we found this place so quickly after moving here. Thank you TMAB 42nd team for an amazing job!
Throw Me A Bone has such an incredible vibe...it's clean and bright and the folks who work there are so kind. They were really helpful with a last minute booking. And my pup loves it!

We are new to NY and my precious doggo needed day care. So far I’ve used two locations. I like the convenient locations and I liked the updates and pics they sent throughout the day that helped ease my anxiety.

I wish certain locations were open on the weekends but that’s my only complaint.
The staff is great and friendly!
They did an amazing job. Very patient and the perfect cut. My dog looks so good! Always go back because it's worth every penny.
My dogs runs to the this door and wags his tail waiting to be let in!💞

I took my dog Sophie to Wesley at Throw Me a Bone, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Sophie usually isn’t a fan of getting groomed, but Wesley was incredibly patient and gentle with her the entire time. He took his time to make sure she was comfortable and calm, and the results were amazing she looks and smells fantastic! You can really tell he cares about the dogs he works with. I’m so grateful to have found someone who handles Sophie with such kindness and professionalism. Highly recommend Wesley!

I can not recommend these guys more... I had just gone back to work in the office and I wasn't sure what I was going to do...I literally considered not taking a new job.  And TMAB - like a miracle - showed up in my building.  The owners Adam and Mike are amazing... and Natalie is fantastic... my dog Oliver is a stray and is very very nervous around new people ...they took the time needed to let him feel safe...especially Mike - who easily waiting 2 weeks for him to stop barking at him...and now he is in love ...at night when we pass the door to Throw me a Bone...he goes towards the door... tail in the air... I have to say no boo boo... outside... ha!  Very sweet team and you can see how much they love animals.   They are also very flexible, and reliable...  I have a crazy schedule and they pivot easily. Recommend highly!
I have been taking my dog to TMAB for the past fews years. The staff are great with my dog and always accommodate to her nervous tendencies. I also love that you get a free daycare day with a groom!

Amazing experience from start to finish. We have been seeing Wesley for over a year now and takes amazing care of our pup. Our Boston Terrier has black nails and we have had a hard time finding someone who will trim them appropriately. Wesley explained how he knows how much to trim and is so gentle when grinding them down. Could not be happier!

Really great place with awesome staff. We've brought Basil here since moving to the neighborhood and we've had nothing but positive experiences. I love that I can always check-in on him on the cam if I need too. The app is great for scheduling appointments and messaging staff as well.

The staff is amazing and so great with our puppy, Archie! Archie has so much fun when we he goes there to play with his other friends. It's nice to know our puppy is in a safe place when his parents are at work!
The staff was very caring and wonderful.

Had a great experience with the grooming team here. My husky had a good bath and deshedding service, she looked so much better after. The staff was friendly and my dog was not stressed from the experience.

10/10 would recommend Wesley and TMAB in general! He always does an amazing job cutting my dog's hair—my pup comes home looking adorable and feeling happy every time. Highly recommend Wesley to anyone looking for a top-notch groomer!
Amazing Company. Would not trust anyone else with our Dog.
Elvis lived his bath rooming.  He was happy and smelled great.  We will definitely be back.
Amazing experience here. Throw me a bone did a great job with my 4 month old puppy.

Reuben, our Yorkie puppy, had a perfect first-time experience socializing with other dogs! The staff was friendly and reliable, doing a great job of helping him get comfortable. He started out nervous but left feeling confident and happy. Overall, it was a fantastic and fun experience for him. Highly recommend!!

I have been using the services of TMAB for approx 2 years. I have utilized the daycare, and grooming regularly as well as the overnight boarding for my dog Tulip on several occasions.
Their staff is kind and caring towards all of the dogs, and their knowledge of each individual dogs needs and personality is reassuring especially if you have an anxious dog like mine! Fully recommend!

Highly recommend Throw Me A Bone. It’s been stressful leaving our dog to go back to the office. We know our dog is always safe and happy!! Staff is extremely friendly, and our dog gets so excited when he sees them. We’ve also used for several overnights while we’ve been away.
I would absolutely recommend TMAB! The care that my pup receives from them is amazing. He is always excited to go to daycare, and loves being around the staff!

Everyone at Throw me a bone is loving, caring and playful with our pup Loki! He enjoys his day care time there every week! We can't be thankful enough for the amazing team at Throw me a bone!! Loki loves you!!

I can’t say enough good things about this puppy daycare! From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed and completely at ease. The staff truly love dogs — it shows in the way they care, play, and interact with every pup. My puppy comes home happy, tired, and well-socialized every time. If you’re looking for a trustworthy, loving, and professional daycare for your fur baby, this is the place. Highly recommend!

Wesley is a magician of a groomer!! We have a shiba and she originally hated going to the groomers, but luckily we found Wesley at throw me a bone and he’s given her the best grooming experience. We’ve been going to Wesley for over 3 years and he’s helped her calm down so much and she no longer hates getting a shower. We highly recommend booking a grooming at throw me a bone!
Great team, my dog is always happy to be there!

My furry baby, Ozzy, absolutely loves the staff and other furry guests at Throw Me A Bone. He waits for them to pick him up each morning like he's excited to be going to Disneyland :)
I also appreciate their flexibility and willingness to accommodate my last minute needs associated with my work life. I feel comfortable that Ozzy is in good hands, and most importantly, enjoying himself.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with Throw Me a Bone and couldn’t be happier with the care and attention they’ve shown our dog, Oreo. From the very beginning, the team made us feel completely at ease, and it was clear that Oreo was in good hands. Oreo absolutely loves going to throw me a bone and gets so excited each time! They send photos throughout the day and have a video cam to watch your pup having fun!

Our pug Oliver goes to daycare at the 42nd street location and he is a big fan!  He knows the days that he goes and he runs in!  All the staff members are great and they love Oliver.  We get pictures throughout the day and they have cameras where you can see the rooms. Oliver mostly naps because he’s a little lazy but it’s a comfort that he’s not alone during the day when we have to work.

Groomer, Wesley Vazquez did the best grooming job I have seen on my dog Brave! He also asked l as many questions as possible to understand what I was looking for and to also educate me about me dog’s breed. Great staff, wonderful customer service, and amazing work. I have tried others around and had horrible experience were my dog was cut or given a badly haircut. Thank you so much, Wesley!!! They are lucky to have you. I’ll definitely be back as long as he is there.

My golden retriever absolutely loves this daycare! The staff is so friendly and caring, always making sure my pup gets plenty of playtime, cuddles, and attention. I feel completely at ease knowing my dog is in a safe, fun, and loving environment—highly recommend!

I’m so happy these guys are in my building! It’s so convenient! My puppy Ginger loves going there! She has a blast. The staff is so friendly and they always send you photos of the doggies. So happy I found them!

Wesley is by far the best groomer I’ve ever used for my poodle mix. I’ve had the worst experience with groomers in NY and in Europe and was really hesitant to have someone cut his hair again. However, Wesley looked at the photo I showed him and walked me through the different clips he was going to use for my pups cut.
When I picked up my pup I was soooo happy with the results. I would highly recommend this location and would ask for Wesley.

Koko, my pup just moved from California to New York and is quite shy. She has been groomed twice by Wesley and absolutely LOVES him! She even allowed him to brush her teeth, which she has NEVER let me do so. The whole staff is friendly and treats your Pup as if they are Family

Can not say enough about Wesley at Throw Me a Bone! Just moved here from California and he did one of the best grooming jobs Ive ever seen on our mini goldendoodle, Honey. We will definitely be back to see Wesley in a few weeks! …
Wesley was amazing! Patient, informative  and very professional!
Best dog daycare and super convient with friendly staff and mgmt!

My frenchie Aspen is absolutely obsessed with TMAB. She pulls me there on a daily basis. This has been such a great place for her to learn how to socialize (she's attended since she was 6 months old). She has made so many friends and I love …
The people at 42nd Street location have been the best. It is obvious they care about their charges. They have been very accommodating with my dog's eccentricities.
